title: [AI-DRAFT] Kitty scoreboard v1: voice-note utterances with expected tasks
status: Draft for review. Expected values are the author's judgement, not measured model output. Review and correct before using as a pass/fail gate.

household.note: Hinglish words (kal, didi, subah) are written in Latin script, as the en-IN recogniser would. Speech is deliberately messy: fillers, repeats, restatements, garbled brands, background chatter.

scoring.per_case: A case passes when the outcome is right, every required task is matched (all title_has words present, case-insensitive), there are no extra tasks beyond required and optional_tasks, every expected field matches, and no must_not item is violated.
scoring.fields_ignored_until_schema_has_them: Anything under 'future' (quantity, place). Until then that text may sit in instructions or the title and is not penalised.
scoring.first_try_rate: Share of cases that pass with no edit. This is the headline number.
scoring.visible_outcome_rate: Share of turns that end in a card, a question, an answer, or an intentional wait (H04, H05). A silent or looping turn is a failure.
scoring.latency: Seconds from last word to preview. Report median and worst.
scoring.run_it: Several runs per case on the real model. Report a pass rate per case, not one run.
